instruction: Fix `partition` in `seqops/transforms.py` (and the shared comparator it relies on) so elements equal to the pivot land in the `equal` bucket. A refactor changed `default_compare` in `seqops/_utils.py` to return a boolean and rewrote `partition` without an equal branch, so pivot-equal elements are misclassified into `greater`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/_utils.py b/seqops/_utils.py
--- a/seqops/_utils.py
+++ b/seqops/_utils.py
@@ -7,4 +7,4 @@
     Returns a negative int when ``a < b``, zero when equal, and a positive int
     when ``a > b`` (mirroring the legacy ``cmp`` builtin).
     """
-    return a < b
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)
diff --git a/seqops/merge.py b/seqops/merge.py
--- a/seqops/merge.py
+++ b/seqops/merge.py
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@
     result = []
     i = j = 0
     while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
-        if default_compare(left[i], right[j]):
+        if default_compare(left[i], right[j]) <= 0:
             result.append(left[i])
             i += 1
         else:
diff --git a/seqops/transforms.py b/seqops/transforms.py
--- a/seqops/transforms.py
+++ b/seqops/transforms.py
@@ -56,8 +56,11 @@
     """
     less, equal, greater = [], [], []
     for item in items:
-        if default_compare(item, pivot):
+        c = default_compare(item, pivot)
+        if c < 0:
             less.append(item)
+        elif c == 0:
+            equal.append(item)
         else:
             greater.append(item)
     return less, equal, greater
